topic: Unit Testing with JUnit and Mockito
learningObjectives: Explain the purpose of unit testing in Java applications.
Create test structures using JUnit assertions and lifecycle methods.
Use mocks to isolate dependencies during unit testing.

activities.title: Unit Test Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the important parts of a JUnit test.

content.concept: A unit test typically prepares input, invokes the behavior under test, and verifies the result with assertions. JUnit annotations identify test and lifecycle methods.

activities.title: Arrange-Act-Assert
activities.instruction: Arrange the phases of a unit test correctly.

content.concept: Arrange-Act-Assert separates test preparation, execution, and verification, making the purpose of a test easier to understand.

content.concept: JUnit assertions allow tests to verify expected values, conditions, nullability, and other outcomes.
